_comment: Immutable coordinates for the dotmac-kernel release this assembly pins.
AGENTS.md rule 30 (Governance ADR 0013 s 1): a release claim is not a
repository-local fact. A version string in pyproject.toml says which
kernel this assembly ASKS for; it is no evidence that such a release
exists or which bytes it is. The peeled commit below therefore carries
its oracle, and the oracle is an annotated tag in the kernel's own
canonical repository rather than anything readable here.
Read by scripts/kernel_adoption_observation.py, which supplies it to the
the coordinate a reader who was not present uses to re-derive the module
lists a surface verdict was taken against.
A version present here is NOT an adoption claim. It records what the
release IS, not that this assembly runs it.

releases.oracle_detail: refs/tags/dotmac-kernel-v0.1.0a98^{} in https://github.com/michaelayoade/dotmac_starter_mt, resolved 2026-09-06 with `git ls-remote --tags`. The tag object is 8c63609d976b460369d1247b63652a57cb5ffa86; the PEELED commit is the coordinate recorded here, because an annotated tag's own object id is not the source it points at.
releases.wheel_sha256_source: poetry.lock, the resolution this assembly installs. A repository-local read, NOT a registry attestation.
